finite_five.retention: Strict lower counted raw dark rate wins; ties all rejected. All non-dark suboutcomes retained as classical alternatives.
finite_five.prior: Localized sheet; mass 1/5 trivial and 2/5 on each pair.

physical_profile.interpretation: Fixed physical gain, input, and record give the same coordinate table under every change of Fourier embedding. A genuinely different selected physical gain need not preserve spacings under native T-neighbour isometries. The example uses prescribed single-step transfers; its sheet table is conditional on that route and the four outcomes.

named_five_diamond_oracle.scope: Raw probabilities expressed as rational plus coefficient times sqrt(5), using the named convention T maps to exp(2*pi*i*r/5). The oracle calculates each port from signed coordinate paths and evaluates every cyclic autocorrelation before averaging any tags.

indexing: Across every fixed graph the menu label v is the literal physical diamond h, so the folded rank is fold(r dot v). The archived first-index report used twice this rank, swapping the two named five-sheet planes while leaving aggregate probabilities invariant.
limitations: The exact five-sheet finite table is a one-register gain-one/gain-two classifier including all count-pair outcomes. The multisheet yields are ideal identification limits, not finite-time observations. Single-step routing records give known sheet translations; the stated fixed scanner block count excludes routing. The exact group-ring identity concerns real Gram entries. The sign of the imaginary orientation is free.
